summary: Frontend-only portfolio site tested via Playwright at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Hero, Navbar anchors, Portfolio filter (All=9, Branding=3, Packaging=3, Social Media=1), Services (10 cards), Design Process (6 steps), FAQ accordion (expands/collapses), Contact form submission (opens correct wa.me URL with pre-filled message), Floating WhatsApp button (hidden at scrollY=0, visible after scroll>300), and Footer (email, IG, quick links, services) all work correctly. All wa.me links point to 919322994747. Two issues discovered: (1) Toast system is mis-wired (Contact validation/success toasts never render), (2) /logo.svg appears broken in the navbar (naturalWidth=0, alt text shown as fallback).

ui_bugs.issue: Toast mismatch: Contact.jsx uses shadcn `useToast` from '../hooks/use-toast', but App.js mounts Toaster from './components/ui/sonner'. Result: neither the 'Missing Information' validation toast nor the 'Redirecting to WhatsApp' success toast is ever displayed. Verified in DOM: no [role=status/alert] and no sonner toast elements appear after clicking submit with empty fields.

/logo.svg fetches with 200 image/svg+xml but img.naturalWidth=0 in browser; navbar shows the alt text 'Design World' with a broken-image icon instead of rendering the SVG logo. File content itself is valid but browser is not rendering it (possibly because SVG lacks viewBox — some browsers report 0 intrinsic size and fail to display when width/height CSS rules don't force size). Suggest adding viewBox='0 0 200 50' to /app/frontend/public/logo.svg.

integration_issues.issue: User gets no visible feedback when submitting empty form (JS validation fires but toast never renders). HTML5 required attributes mask this in normal flow, but if a user bypasses (e.g., only fills name), the JS-side toast still won't show.

issues: Logo image not visually rendering; falls back to alt text with broken-image glyph

action_items: Fix toast wiring: either (a) replace Toaster import in App.js with the shadcn Toaster from './components/ui/toaster', or (b) refactor Contact.jsx to use sonner's `toast` API (import { toast } from 'sonner') to match the mounted Toaster.
Add viewBox='0 0 200 50' (and/or preserveAspectRatio) to /app/frontend/public/logo.svg so it renders reliably at h-12 w-auto in the navbar. Alternatively, set explicit width class on the .
Consider adding data-testid attributes to key interactive elements (nav links, portfolio filter buttons, form fields, submit button, FAB) for more robust testing.
critical_code_review_comments: Toast library mismatch (shadcn useToast vs sonner Toaster) is a silent UX bug — user-facing feedback is completely missing on the contact form.
Hero.jsx calls useTransform inside JSX (lines 41, 136) which creates a new hook on every render — while it works currently, it's an anti-pattern; hoist those to component top level.
Contact form only validates presence, not email format — consider a regex or type='email' validity check for better UX.
No data-testid attributes across interactive components — hurts testability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Main issues: (1) toast library mismatch in App.js (sonner Toaster) vs Contact.jsx (shadcn useToast). After fix, re-verify by removing required attrs and submitting empty form -> expect 'Missing Information' toast. (2) Logo SVG rendering issue — verify nav img has non-zero naturalWidth after fix. All other flows (nav scroll, portfolio filter, services count=10, process steps=6, FAQ toggle, WA URL open, FAB toggle on scroll, footer content) passed.
